DewStat Bi-LSTM report: 102 regions

Soil moisture 10–40 cm from satellite data only, now on 102 regions across US climate zones and scored on 22 regions the model never saw (2024 onward). Satellite data 2016+ (NASA's archive for 2016–2019, Microsoft's copy from 2020). Version 1 predicts soil moisture directly; version 2 predicts wetter or drier than each spot's normal and adds a stored normal map back; version 3 is version 2 with SWIR moisture indices (NDMI, NDWI) in place of VCI.
